recap.text: Circe Took, a mantis hive queen and businesswoman, moderates a CrawlCon panel where she cuts a table in half beside Crawler Carl. She enters the game as Diwata to help her daughter, Vrah, by filling a castle with nymphs. Princess Donut strips away Diwata's god armor with Laundry Day, and a dozen of Circe Took's own children kill her while she shrieks Carl's name.

beats.headline: Moderated by Circe Took
beats.text: CrawlCon programme, as printed. Panel: Crawling Through the Ages. Crawlers both new and old lead a discussion on the current state of the crawl, followed by a Q&A, special guests to be announced. Moderated by Circe Took of the Hive. Next item down, an autograph session with Crawler Carl, refunds guaranteed if he does not survive long enough to attend. The listing does not mention any history between the moderator and the fan favourite.
beats.gist: Circe Took of the Hive moderates a CrawlCon panel called Crawling Through the Ages.

beats.headline: A daughter lost on her first hunt
beats.text: Briefing from Zev, four hours before the panel. Circe Took: a minor hive queen, a mantis, outside both the military and the Burrower clan. She started out as a hunter, was quite famous for a while, and is now a businesswoman who owns an amusement park. Crawler Carl killed her child: Xindy, Vrah's little sister, on her very first hunt. Zev's assessment is that the mantis people are overly dramatic about everything and a hive queen probably has ten thousand children. Her advice: avoid the subject of her government.
beats.gist: Zev briefs Carl four hours before the panel about Circe Took, a mantis hive queen.

beats.headline: The table, cut in two
beats.text: Panel footage. Circe Took is the size of a mantaur, with folded blade arms a metre long, and she can see Crawler Carl before the audience can. Her opening remark is that his luck is a dishonour on the hive. Her second is an arm brought down through the table beside him. Had he truly been sitting there, it would have cut him in half. She then introduces the panel, talks over the author mid-sentence, and informs the room that the season's top crawler has not long to live.
beats.gist: Circe Took is a queen and moderator.

beats.headline: Bored to death, on air
beats.text: Circe Took lectures for almost ten minutes on the history of the crawl, the Hive's place in it, and the danger of the Indigenous Species Protection Act. Crawler Carl bangs his head on the table and announces she has succeeded in boring him to death. When he turns to her dead child, she orders him cut off. A robed woman at the back says no, and Circe accuses the room of a setup to mock her child's death. She is not the Maestro, she says, and she is not so easily trapped.
beats.gist: Circe Took lectures on the crawl and the Indigenous Species Protection Act until Carl bangs his head.

beats.headline: About the other daughters
beats.text: The robed woman leaves. Circe Took calls her a godsdamned bitch and swears to kill her, throws the broken piece of table at the wall, and heads for the exit. Crawler Carl asks the room for the best way to kill Vrah. She freezes where she stands while the audience answers: eight left, one of them a male who stays in Zockau to deal with the trade representatives, seven warriors including Vrah, all Dark Hive. Invited back to the table, she hisses that she means to hunt down, personally, whoever harms her other daughters, and stomps out.
beats.gist: Circe Took swears to kill a robed woman and throws a broken table piece at the wall.

beats.headline: Gone apeshit, in transit
beats.text: Gossip at the autograph tables, logged because it is consistent. Circe Took has, in the phrasing of the attendees, gone completely apeshit about the whole business with her daughter, and is on her way to the Earth system to do something about it. Crawler Carl cannot see what: it is too late for her to join the hunters on this floor. A reporter begins, "With the news that Circe Took is possibly..." and is shoved aside by a naga before finishing.
beats.gist: Circe Took goes apeshit about her daughter and travels to the Earth system.

beats.headline: The note under the note
beats.text: A benefactor box note, with extra words that appear once Crawler Carl's Escape Plan skill activates: Circe sponsored Diwata. Vrah's mother is coming into the game. The box was sent before the party failed the odious creeper quest, so she had already bought the god before winning the court case to free her daughter, and meant to come for him whatever happened. His reading: she needs to save face. He humiliated her and injured her daughter, and somehow she is still talking to Vrah, which is against the rules.
beats.gist: Circe sponsored Diwata and Vrah's mother enters the game.

beats.headline: A squirrel out of a hunter
beats.text: Crawler Elle McGibbons reports from outside a church. A green explosion, a bush with a giant flower pod, and inside the pod a hunter, who swallows the blood and bark of the dead tree guards and swells until he bursts. Out of the gore comes an antlered squirrel covered in hunter pieces: Diwata, sponsored by Circe Took, on a five-minute timer. It flies away like a rocket. Crawler Carl works out the destination. Her daughter. His word for the errand is a cure.
beats.gist: Crawler Elle McGibbons reports a green explosion and a hunter who bursts from a flower pod.

beats.headline: Babies, sent out into the world
beats.text: Baby mantises are everywhere outside the castle. Crawler Elle McGibbons has the rest of it from a hunter with no eyebrows: Vrah's people tricked his brother into walking into the temple, where he was used as the birthing vessel for Diwata. They murdered another hunter to cure Vrah of a venereal disease. And now, in Elle's words, the Circe bug lady is having actual flesh-and-blood babies and sending them out into the world. Nobody present knows what becomes of them when the floor collapses.
beats.gist: Circe sends flesh-and-blood babies into the world outside the castle.

beats.headline: One more mantis in the castle
beats.text: Crawler Carl assembles it all at once. Diwata, which is to say Circe Took, is in the castle, blended in with the rest of the mantises, there to help her daughter. She meant to break the connection between the goodwill ballrooms and end the party, but a capacitor keeps them running. The fallback: fill the castle with nymphs, give the hunters back their magic, and wait for somebody to break the peace seal, so that Vrah can get clear in the chaos.
beats.gist: Circe Took is a queen and moderator who blends in with mantises to help her daughter.

beats.headline: Died shrieking his name
beats.text: Corner four of the final arena: Diwata, burning, looking exactly like her true identity, a baby mantis halfway out of her. Crawler Princess Donut casts Laundry Day at level fifteen. It cannot harm a god, but the god is only armour, and the spell strips it off the driver. Diwata leaves the floor. Circe Took stands up wet and covered in bubbles and begins to say she does not need the god's protection. A dozen of her own children fall on her before she finishes. She dies shrieking Crawler Carl's name.
beats.gist: Princess Donut casts Laundry Day on Diwata. A dozen children fall on Circe Took. She dies shrieking.

relations.note: Moderator of Crawling Through the Ages
